h: Chris Brown reportedly given a suspended eight-month prison sentence over a 2023 nightclub brawl
p: A UK court has reportedly handed the singer a suspended eight-month sentence after he pleaded guilty to a public order offence linked to a brawl at a London nightclub in 2023. Being suspended, the term is not served unless conditions are breached.
more: The case dates back to an incident at a London nightclub in 2023.
The singer had pleaded guilty to a public order offence.
